messages:
Michelle: Hi team — attaching INV-2026-0892 for ACME (private deployment). Invoice shows a platform fee proration AND a full monthly platform fee for the same period. Can we confirm whether the migration credit was applied? https://redwood.app/invoices/INV-2026-0892.pdf
Sam: I reviewed the contract. There was an executed amendment (signed 2026-02-12) that increases their support to Enterprise and grants a 4-week migration credit on platform fees. Invoice shouldn't have both charges. I'm pulling the signed doc now.
Zack: customer confirmed upgrade via email on 2026-02-13 — I uploaded the thread to GDrive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abcd-MIGRATION_EMAIL
Ben: FYI, our infra telemetry shows a brief concurrency spike during cutover (2026-02-08). That explains a usage line item labeled `overage-concurrency` on the invoice. But that is separate from the platform fee proration issue.
Olga: Can someone paste the invoice lines? accounting needs GL mapping before we process any credits. Also need the amendment PDF or signed SOW to attach.
Michelle: Invoice lines: ```
INV-2026-0892 line items:
- Private platform fee (prorated) $18,000
- Private platform fee (monthly) $36,000
- Support (standard) $5,000
- Overage: concurrency $2,200
``` Looks like support stayed at "standard" on invoice but contract moved to Enterprise.
Sam: That's the bug — sales updated Salesforce but the billing sync didn't pick up the support-tier change. Filed SF->Billing sync ticket. Also the migration credit should have subtracted $18,000.
Olga: OK. For a corrective credit we need: 1) signed amendment PDF, 2) CS confirmation, 3) a short approver note from Finance. Once we have those we can issue credit journal CJ-2026-0145.
Zack: I can attach the email thread and confirm the customer wants the credit instead of re-billing.
Michelle: I've created Jira FIN-4321 to track the corrective credit and sync fix. Requesting approval to issue immediate credit for the duplicate platform fee ($18,000) and an adjustment to support line to Enterprise rate. Approver: CFO (Priya).
InvoiceBot: Invoice INV-2026-0892 created by billing-system at 1968001200. Status: posted.
Priya: @Michelle I reviewed FIN-4321 and docs. Approve issuing a credit for the duplicate platform fee. Finance to hold on adjustments to overage until we reconcile actual usage vs. meter. :thumbsup:
Michelle: Thanks @Priya — Olga, please proceed with CJ-2026-0145 and update the invoice status. Also loop in Legal if we need to push a corrected invoice to ACME.
Olga: Will do. Posting final checklist here once credit is posted.
Sam: I'll follow up on the SF->Billing sync fix and make sure future amendments propagate.
Zack: I'll confirm with ACME that they're OK with the credit path.
Michelle: Closing notes: action items:
- Olga: create credit journal, update invoice status (due today)
- Sam: fix SF->Billing sync and post root cause in FIN-4321
- Ben: provide usage export for the overage line by EOD 
- Zack: customer sign-off on credit
- Michelle: notify sales leader and close the loop
:eyes:
